supersedes: V0_1 count-only interpretation on the same proposal branch
refinementReason: Current recorder uses INSERT OR IGNORE and milestone event windows span multiple scheduled minutes. attemptedCount > storedCount can be legitimate idempotent replay, so count equality alone cannot define completeness.
goal: Permit a plan-day NO-BUY classification only when every scheduled monitor opportunity and every expected recorder event is positively accounted for.

dayRunCoverage.monitorWindowTaipei: 09:00 through 13:24 inclusive on a trading day
dayRunCoverage.rule: A missing scheduled run receipt is a monitor/recorder gap. It remains UNKNOWN/INCOMPLETE, never NO_BUY.

runReceipt.symbolRule: Every plan symbol expected to be monitored must have a status for that run. result.ok=false is a coverage failure for NO-BUY inference.
runReceipt.idempotencyRule: Idempotent INSERT OR IGNORE replay is accounted only in alreadyPresentVerifiedCount, and only when the exact expected event key exists in the exact-date row set. skippedByReason is reserved for non-idempotent skips and makes NO-BUY completeness fail closed.
runReceipt.failOpenRule: Any failOpen/errorClass/failedCount > 0 makes the affected run non-complete.

rowContract.rule: All pages must be consumed or an equivalent bounded exact-date full set must be positively proven. LIMIT-only readers are UNKNOWN.

signalSemantics.buyPositive: A V8 trade-journal BUY row already proves positive Formal BUY signal price/time.
signalSemantics.noBuy: A plan-day may be classified COMPLETE_NO_BUY only when all 265 expected runs are covered for that plan, no run has result/error gaps, and no expected/persisted Formal BUY event exists.
signalSemantics.planInvalidated: PLAN_INVALIDATED is an observed abstention episode, not a terminal day state; later recovery can still produce BUY under current state machine.
signalSemantics.fill: NO-BUY completeness says nothing about broker fills.

protectedInvariants: No monitor or push eligibility change
